driveCorpusEvidence: Current Drive inventory includes newly ingested text/PDF resources such as 00014.txt through 00022.txt and 00049.txt/00050.txt with corresponding PDFs where available.
method: Each study is built only from verified source extracts already ingested from the connected Drive corpus. Selection is thematic rather than mechanical: evidence units are ranked by heading and lexical affinity, source diversity is enforced where the corpus permits, and deterministic seed/rotation variants permit a large research catalogue without changing source wording. Editorial text is restricted to transparent source-critical academic apparatus and corpus-level description; it does not introduce external historical facts. Every reproduced paragraph carries an extract/source citation, differing source perspectives remain attributed to their authors, and no contradiction is silently reconciled.
qualityGate: A study is publishable only if it contains at least 4,500 verified source words, at least 8 evidence units, at least 2 distinct registered sources where available, 100% provenance, no unsupported factual paragraphs, no unverified quotations, paragraph-level citations, source criticism, limitations and bibliography, and an academic quality score of at least 90/100.
